question: Which country was a major importer of dye intermediates and castor oils from India in 2022-23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• China emerged as a major importer of dye intermediates and castor oils from India during the financial year 2022-23.
 
• Dye intermediates are chemical compounds used in the production of dyes, which are widely utilized in textiles, leather, and other industries.
 
• Castor oil is a versatile product that is heavily used in industries such as cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and lubricants.
 
• India is one of the largest producers of castor oil globally, and China is among the key markets for Indian castor oil exports.
 
• The strong trade relations between India and China make China a significant destination for various Indian chemical and agricultural exports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dye Intermediates:**

 
 
• These are precursors used in manufacturing dyes for the textile, paint, and leather industries.
 
• India is one of the leading global suppliers of dye intermediates due to its advanced chemical manufacturing capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Castor Oil:**
 
 
• Extracted from castor seeds, it is known for its high viscosity and lubricating properties.
 
• India accounts for over 90% of global castor seed production, making it the largest exporter of castor oil.
 
 
 
• **India-China Trade:**
 
 
• China is one of India's largest trading partners, with extensive imports and exports across various sectors.
 
• The trade relations encompass not only chemicals but also electronics, machinery, and other goods.
 
 
 
• **Export Dynamics:**
 
 
• India's export of dye intermediates and castor oil reflects the country's strong position in agricultural and chemical industries.
 
• These exports contribute significantly to India's foreign exchange earnings.
